provenance.origin: Frame at 0.75 s of the user's 2026-08-26 dark-arena screen recording in which the real WIN was missed because the detector never armed (the v21 regression).

truth.basis: The implementer viewed the full ROI: it shows dark-arena combat with an AC part in the foreground and no result text. The checked frame class is the legacy expectation from tests/manifest.json.

privacy.notes: The implementer inspected the full ROI at 2x. No player or opponent name, Steam identifier, notification, third-party overlay, desktop, local path, token or secret is visible, and the PPM header carries no comment field. Rotated decal lettering on an AC part is visible; it is part of the in-game AC model rather than a name plate or other identity element, and an independent reviewer should confirm that reading.

redistribution.notes: Committed by the repository owner in the initial public release (af06299, 2026-08-30) and public since. It contains ARMORED CORE VI game imagery; this records where the asset came from, not a licence determination.
